title: Review: crypto2dev-shim pre-merge
description: Pre-merge code review of the crypto2dev CryptoCb port per PROMPT-review-myoss.md. Covers correctness, maintainer burden, efficiency, elegance, and readability of wolfcrypt/src/port/crypto2dev/ and its headers.
notes: Confidence revised: 90% chance of no missed bug. DO_SIGN/DO_VERIFY uncertainty resolved by reading WOLFKM/src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c:1198-1291. The kernel handlers receive (state, file, arg): state is the calling fd's state, file is the struct file for the calling fd. The state parameter is NOT used inside either handler at all — only file->f_op is checked (to verify key_fd is also a crypto2dev fd) and op.key_fd carries all key context. Issuing DO_SIGN/DO_VERIFY on a pool-acquired operation fd is confirmed correct. Remaining uncertainty (10%): no GCM truncated-tag KAT in the test suite (truncation path traced through the sim but not exercised with a NIST vector).
